# Requirement
```text
1.Overview
This project implements a grid-based puzzle game called Inertia. The core mechanic is inertial sliding: once the player chooses a direction, the character slides continuously in that direction until it hits a Wall or enters a StopCell. The objective is to navigate the board to collect all Gems while avoiding Mines that cause death and life loss. The game features a scoring system, life management, and an Undo system to backtrack moves.
2.Functional Requirements
The system manages 2D grid coordinates and their deltas through the Position and PositionOffset classes for all
movement calculations and boundary checks. In GameBoardController.makeMove, when a move is initiated via a Direction,
the player piece moves step-by-step from its current Position. If the player successfully slides at least one cell and the movement ends by a normal stopping condition, such as a Wall, boundary, or StopCell, without hitting a Mine, the result is Alive. During an Alive move, any Gem or ExtraLife passed through is collected, removed from the board, and recorded in the Alive result.
 Sliding stops immediately before a Wall, at the board boundary, or exactly
on a StopCell. StopCell is a special cell type that can only contain a Player entity. Hitting a Mine causes a Dead result and stops movement. The position recorded for the player after a Dead move is the original position. The board remains unchanged from before the move, and any Gem or ExtraLife passed before the Mine is not collected or removed.
A move returns
Invalid when the player cannot move at all (blocked by Wall or boundary on the first step, resulting in zero movement
distance). Every move must return a MoveResult (Alive, Dead, or Invalid); collected Gems and ExtraLives are recorded only in Alive results.
 In GameState, getNumGems() returns the number of Gems still present on the GameBoard (i.e., remaining Gems).A player wins when there are no Gems left on the board (getNumGems() == 0). A player loses when lives reach zero (unless in unlimited lives mode).For scoring, the number of collected Gems is initialNumOfGems - getNumGems(), and the score is calculated as : Score = InitialBoardSize + (CollectedGems * 10) - (Moves * 1) - (Undoes * 2) - (Deaths * 4). If numLives is less than zero, the player has unlimited lives, and
getNumLives returns Integer.MAX_VALUE. 
In GameController.processMove, Invalid moves do not change counters and are not pushed to the MoveStack. Alive moves increment numMoves, apply collected ExtraLife effects, and are pushed to the MoveStack. Dead moves increment numMoves and numDeaths, decrease finite lives by one, and are not pushed to the MoveStack. Only Alive moves are undoable.
processUndo pops one Alive move if available, restores the player position and collected Gems/ExtraLives, reverses finite ExtraLife gains, and returns true. If no move is available, it returns false. Undo does not decrement numMoves; undo count is represented by MoveStack.popCount.

GameStateSerializer: A tool for loading/saving the game state from/to text format, handling the mapping between characters (W, P, S, G, M, L) and Ecore classes. 
InertiaTextGame: The main runner handling the STDIN loop and parsing user commands like U, D, Undo, or Quit. 
```

# Requirement
```text
1.Overview
This project implements a grid-based puzzle game called Inertia. The core mechanic is inertial sliding: once the player chooses a direction, the character slides continuously in that direction until it hits a Wall or enters a StopCell. The objective is to navigate the board to collect all Gems while avoiding Mines that cause death and life loss. The game features a scoring system, life management, and an Undo system to backtrack moves.
2.Functional Requirements
The system manages 2D grid coordinates and their deltas through the Position and PositionOffset classes for all
movement calculations and boundary checks. In GameBoardController.makeMove, when a move is initiated via a Direction,
the player piece moves step-by-step from its current Position. If the player successfully slides at least one cell and the movement ends by a normal stopping condition, such as a Wall, boundary, or StopCell, without hitting a Mine, the result is Alive. During an Alive move, any Gem or ExtraLife passed through is collected, removed from the board, and recorded in the Alive result.
 Sliding stops immediately before a Wall, at the board boundary, or exactly
on a StopCell. StopCell is a special cell type that can only contain a Player entity. Hitting a Mine causes a Dead result and stops movement. The position recorded for the player after a Dead move is the original position. The board remains unchanged from before the move, and any Gem or ExtraLife passed before the Mine is not collected or removed.
A move returns
Invalid when the player cannot move at all (blocked by Wall or boundary on the first step, resulting in zero movement
distance). Every move must return a MoveResult (Alive, Dead, or Invalid); collected Gems and ExtraLives are recorded only in Alive results.
 In GameState, getNumGems() returns the number of Gems still present on the GameBoard (i.e., remaining Gems).A player wins when there are no Gems left on the board (getNumGems() == 0). A player loses when lives reach zero (unless in unlimited lives mode).For scoring, the number of collected Gems is initialNumOfGems - getNumGems(), and the score is calculated as : Score = InitialBoardSize + (CollectedGems * 10) - (Moves * 1) - (Undoes * 2) - (Deaths * 4). If numLives is less than zero, the player has unlimited lives, and
getNumLives returns Integer.MAX_VALUE. 
In GameController.processMove, Invalid moves do not change counters and are not pushed to the MoveStack. Alive moves increment numMoves, apply collected ExtraLife effects, and are pushed to the MoveStack. Dead moves increment numMoves and numDeaths, decrease finite lives by one, and are not pushed to the MoveStack. Only Alive moves are undoable.
processUndo pops one Alive move if available, restores the player position and collected Gems/ExtraLives, reverses finite ExtraLife gains, and returns true. If no move is available, it returns false. Undo does not decrement numMoves; undo count is represented by MoveStack.popCount.

GameStateSerializer: A tool for loading/saving the game state from/to text format, handling the mapping between characters (W, P, S, G, M, L) and Ecore classes. 
InertiaTextGame: The main runner handling the STDIN loop and parsing user commands like U, D, Undo, or Quit. 
```

# Operation Specifications
Position::offsetBy2
Summary:
Returns a new Position obtained by adding the provided PositionOffset to this Position.
Algorithm:
1. Read dRow and dCol from the offset object.
2. Compute newRow = this.row + offset.dRow.
3. Compute newCol = this.col + offset.dCol.
4. Return a new Position(newRow, newCol).
Related Features:
- Position.row
- Position.col
- Position.offsetBy2(offset : PositionOffset) : Position
Related Classes: Position, PositionOffset
Input:
- offset: the row/column delta to apply.
Output:
- Returns a new Position shifted by the offset.
Pre-condition:
- this Position and offset must not be null.
Post-condition:
- A new Position object is created.
- The original Position is not modified.

Position::offsetBy1
Summary:
Returns a new Position obtained by adding the given row and column deltas to this Position.
Algorithm:
1. Compute newRow = this.row + dRow.
2. Compute newCol = this.col + dCol.
3. Return a new Position(newRow, newCol).
Related Features:
- Position.row
- Position.col
- Position.offsetBy1(dRow : int, dCol : int) : Position
Related Classes: Position
Input:
- dRow: signed row delta.
- dCol: signed column delta.
Output:
- Returns a new Position shifted by the specified deltas.
Pre-condition:
- this Position must be initialized.
Post-condition:
- A new Position object is created.
- The original Position is not modified.

Position::offsetByOrNull1
Summary:
Returns the offset Position if it stays within board bounds; otherwise returns null.
Algorithm:
1. Compute candidate row and column by adding dRow and dCol.
2. If candidate row or col is outside [0, numRows) or [0, numCols), return null.
3. Otherwise return a new Position(candidateRow, candidateCol).
Related Features:
- Position.row
- Position.col
- Position.offsetByOrNull1(dRow : int, dCol : int, numRows : int, numCols : int) : Position
Related Classes: Position
Input:
- dRow: signed row delta.
- dCol: signed column delta.
- numRows: total number of board rows; must be positive.
- numCols: total number of board columns; must be positive.
Output:
- Returns a new Position if the offset position is within bounds.
- Returns null if the offset position is outside the board.
Pre-condition:
- numRows and numCols must be positive.
Post-condition:
- The original Position is not modified.
- The return value faithfully represents in-bounds or out-of-bounds movement.

Position::offsetByOrNull2
Summary:
Returns the offset Position if it stays within board bounds; otherwise returns null.
Algorithm:
1. Read dRow and dCol from the provided PositionOffset.
2. Compute candidate row and column by adding the offsets to this Position.
3. If the candidate is outside the board bounds, return null.
4. Otherwise return a new Position(candidateRow, candidateCol).
Related Features:
- Position.row
- Position.col
- Position.offsetByOrNull2(offset : PositionOffset, numRows : int, numCols : int) : Position
Related Classes: Position, PositionOffset
Input:
- offset: the row/column delta to apply.
- numRows: total number of board rows; must be positive.
- numCols: total number of board columns; must be positive.
Output:
- Returns a new in-bounds Position, or null if out of bounds.
Pre-condition:
- this Position and offset must not be null.
- numRows and numCols must be positive.
Post-condition:
- The original Position is not modified.
- The return value is null exactly when the moved position would be outside the board.

During an Alive move, any Gem or ExtraLife passed through is collected, removed from the board, and recorded in the Alive result.
 Sliding stops immediately before a Wall, at the board boundary, or exactly
on a StopCell. StopCell is a special cell type that can only contain a Player entity. Hitting a Mine causes a Dead result and stops movement. The position recorded for the player after a Dead move is the original position. The board remains unchanged from before the move, and any Gem or ExtraLife passed before the Mine is not collected or removed.
A move returns
Invalid when the player cannot move at all (blocked by Wall or boundary on the first step, resulting in zero movement
distance). Every move must return a MoveResult (Alive, Dead, or Invalid); collected Gems and ExtraLives are recorded only in Alive results.
 In GameState, getNumGems() returns the number of Gems still present on the GameBoard (i.e., remaining Gems).A player wins when there are no Gems left on the board (getNumGems() == 0). A player loses when lives reach zero (unless in unlimited lives mode).For scoring, the number of collected Gems is initialNumOfGems - getNumGems(), and the score is calculated as : Score = InitialBoardSize + (CollectedGems * 10) - (Moves * 1) - (Undoes * 2) - (Deaths * 4). If numLives is less than zero, the player has unlimited lives, and
getNumLives returns Integer.MAX_VALUE. 
In GameController.processMove, Invalid moves do not change counters and are not pushed to the MoveStack. Alive moves increment numMoves, apply collected ExtraLife effects, and are pushed to the MoveStack. Dead moves increment numMoves and numDeaths, decrease finite lives by one, and are not pushed to the MoveStack. Only Alive moves are undoable.
processUndo pops one Alive move if available, restores the player position and collected Gems/ExtraLives, reverses finite ExtraLife gains, and returns true. If no move is available, it returns false. Undo does not decrement numMoves; undo count is represented by MoveStack.popCount.

InertiaTextGame: The main runner handling the STDIN loop and parsing user commands like U, D, Undo, or Quit.

1.Overview
This project implements a grid-based puzzle game called Inertia. The core mechanic is inertial sliding: once the player chooses a direction, the character slides continuously in that direction until it hits a Wall or enters a StopCell. The objective is to navigate the board to collect all Gems while avoiding Mines that cause death and life loss. The game features a scoring system, life management, and an Undo system to backtrack moves.
2.Functional Requirements
The system manages 2D grid coordinates and their deltas through the Position and PositionOffset classes for all
movement calculations and boundary checks. In GameBoardController.makeMove, when a move is initiated via a Direction,
the player piece moves step-by-step from its current Position. If the player successfully slides at least one cell and the movement ends by a normal stopping condition, such as a Wall, boundary, or StopCell, without hitting a Mine, the result is Alive. During an Alive move, any Gem or ExtraLife passed through is collected, removed from the board, and recorded in the Alive result.
 Sliding stops immediately before a Wall, at the board boundary, or exactly
on a StopCell. StopCell is a special cell type that can only contain a Player entity. Hitting a Mine causes a Dead result and stops movement. The position recorded for the player after a Dead move is the original position. The board remains unchanged from before the move, and any Gem or ExtraLife passed before the Mine is not collected or removed.

distance). Every move must return a MoveResult (Alive, Dead, or Invalid); collected Gems and ExtraLives are recorded only in Alive results.

  public int getNumGems()
  {
    int count = 0;
    Cell[][] b = getBoard();
    for (int row = 0; row < getNumRows(); row++)
    {
      for (int col = 0; col < getNumCols(); col++)
      {
        Cell cell = b[row][col];
        if (cell instanceof EntityCell)
        {
          Entity entity = ((EntityCell)cell).getEntity();
          if (entity instanceof Gem)
          {
            count++;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return count;
    
  }

   * Summary:
   * Performs one inertial sliding move in the given Direction and returns the corresponding MoveResult.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. Obtain the player's current Position from the GameBoard.
   * 2. Convert Direction to a PositionOffset:
   *    - UP    -> (-1, 0)
   *    - DOWN  -> (1, 0)
   *    - LEFT  -> (0, -1)
   *    - RIGHT -> (0, 1)
   * 3. Initialize current position as the player's position and initialize empty collections for passed gems and extra lives.
   * 4. Repeatedly compute the next position by offsetting current position by one step.
   * 5. If next position is out of bounds:
   *    - If no step has been taken yet, return Invalid.
   *    - Otherwise return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.
   * 6. If next cell is a Wall:
   *    - If no step has been taken yet, return Invalid.
   *    - Otherwise stop immediately before the Wall and return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.
   * 7. If next cell is a StopCell:
   *    - Move the player onto the StopCell and return Alive with newPosition equal to that StopCell position.
   *    - The stop cell may contain only the Player.
   * 8. If next cell contains a Mine:
   *    - Restore the board to its original state for all movement effects.
   *    - Return Dead with newPosition equal to the original player position and minePosition equal to the Mine position.
   * 9. If next cell contains a Gem or ExtraLife:
   *    - Remove that entity from the board, record its position in the corresponding Alive collection, and continue sliding.
   * 10. If next cell is a normal traversable cell:
   *    - Continue sliding.
   * 11. When movement ends by a normal stopping condition after at least one step and no Mine was hit, return Alive.

   * Output:

   * - For Alive, newPosition is the final player position and collectedGems/collectedExtraLives contain all collected item positions in travel order.

  public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
  {
    GameBoard board = getGameBoard();
    Player player = board != null ? board.getPlayer() : null;
    if (board == null || player == null || direction == null)
    {
      return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP: dRow = -1; break;
      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;
      case RIGHT: dCol = 1; break;
    }

    Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
    Position current = originalPosition;
    boolean stepped = false;

    while (true)
    {
      Position next = current.offsetBy1(dRow, dCol);
      Cell nextCell = board.getCell2(next);
      if (nextCell == null)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof Wall)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof StopCell)
      {
        player.setPosition(next);
        alive.setNewPosition(next);
        return alive;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof EntityCell)
      {
        EntityCell entityCell = (EntityCell)nextCell;
        Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();
        if (entity instanceof Mine)
        {
          player.setPosition(originalPosition);
          Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
          dead.setNewPosition(originalPosition);
          dead.setMinePosition(next);
          return dead;

          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedGems().add(next);
        }
        else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
        {
          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedExtraLives().add(next);
        }
      }

      stepped = true;
      current = next;
    }
  }

   * Summary:
   * Performs one inertial sliding move in the given Direction and returns the corresponding MoveResult.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. Obtain the player's current Position from the GameBoard.
   * 2. Convert Direction to a PositionOffset:
   *    - UP    -> (-1, 0)
   *    - DOWN  -> (1, 0)
   *    - LEFT  -> (0, -1)
   *    - RIGHT -> (0, 1)
   * 3. Initialize current position as the player's position and initialize empty collections for passed gems and extra lives.
   * 4. Repeatedly compute the next position by offsetting current position by one step.
   * 5. If next position is out of bounds:
   *    - If no step has been taken yet, return Invalid.
   *    - Otherwise return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.
   * 6. If next cell is a Wall:
   *    - If no step has been taken yet, return Invalid.
   *    - Otherwise stop immediately before the Wall and return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.
   * 7. If next cell is a StopCell:
   *    - Move the player onto the StopCell and return Alive with newPosition equal to that StopCell position.
   *    - The stop cell may contain only the Player.
   * 8. If next cell contains a Mine:
   *    - Restore the board to its original state for all movement effects.
   *    - Return Dead with newPosition equal to the original player position and minePosition equal to the Mine position.
   * 9. If next cell contains a Gem or ExtraLife:
   *    - Remove that entity from the board, record its position in the corresponding Alive collection, and continue sliding.
   * 10. If next cell is a normal traversable cell:
   *    - Continue sliding.
   * 11. When movement ends by a normal stopping condition after at least one step and no Mine was hit, return Alive.

   * Output:
   * - Returns one of:
   *   - Invalid when the player cannot move even one cell.
   *   - Alive when the player slides at least one cell and stops normally without hitting a Mine.
   *   - Dead when the player slides into a Mine.
   * - For Alive, newPosition is the final player position and collectedGems/collectedExtraLives contain all collected item positions in travel order.
   * - For Dead, newPosition is the original player position and minePosition is the Mine location.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - gameBoard and player must be initialized.
   * - The board must be in a consistent state with valid positions and entity ownership.
   * - direction must be non-null.
   * Post-condition:

   *   - any traversed Gems and ExtraLives are removed from the board and recorded in the result.
   *   - board state reflects the move completion.
   * - If Dead:

   *   - no board changes made during the attempt remain visible.
   * - If Invalid:

  public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
  {
    GameBoard board = getGameBoard();
    Player player = board != null ? board.getPlayer() : null;
    if (board == null || player == null || direction == null)
    {
      return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP: dRow = -1; break;
      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;
      case RIGHT: dCol = 1; break;
    }

    Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
    Position current = originalPosition;
    boolean stepped = false;

    while (true)
    {
      Position next = current.offsetBy1(dRow, dCol);
      Cell nextCell = board.getCell2(next);
      if (nextCell == null)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof Wall)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof StopCell)
      {
        player.setPosition(next);
        alive.setNewPosition(next);
        return alive;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof EntityCell)
      {
        EntityCell entityCell = (EntityCell)nextCell;
        Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();
        if (entity instanceof Mine)
        {
          player.setPosition(originalPosition);
          Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
          dead.setNewPosition(originalPosition);
          dead.setMinePosition(next);
          return dead;
        }
        if (entity instanceof Gem)
        {
          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedGems().add(next);
        }
        else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
        {
          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedExtraLives().add(next);
        }
      }

      stepped = true;
      current = next;
    }
  }

   *    - Otherwise stop immediately before the Wall and return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.

    Player player = board != null ? board.getPlayer() : null;

    {
      return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP: dRow = -1; break;
      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;
      case RIGHT: dCol = 1; break;
    }

      Cell nextCell = board.getCell2(next);
      if (nextCell == null)

    int dRow = 0;

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Performs one inertial sliding move in the given Direction and returns the corresponding MoveResult.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. Obtain the player's current Position from the GameBoard.
   * 2. Convert Direction to a PositionOffset:
   *    - UP    -> (-1, 0)
   *    - DOWN  -> (1, 0)
   *    - LEFT  -> (0, -1)
   *    - RIGHT -> (0, 1)
   * 3. Initialize current position as the player's position and initialize empty collections for passed gems and extra lives.
   * 4. Repeatedly compute the next position by offsetting current position by one step.
   * 5. If next position is out of bounds:
   *    - If no step has been taken yet, return Invalid.
   *    - Otherwise return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.
   * 6. If next cell is a Wall:
   *    - If no step has been taken yet, return Invalid.
   *    - Otherwise stop immediately before the Wall and return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.
   * 7. If next cell is a StopCell:
   *    - Move the player onto the StopCell and return Alive with newPosition equal to that StopCell position.
   *    - The stop cell may contain only the Player.
   * 8. If next cell contains a Mine:
   *    - Restore the board to its original state for all movement effects.
   *    - Return Dead with newPosition equal to the original player position and minePosition equal to the Mine position.
   * 9. If next cell contains a Gem or ExtraLife:
   *    - Remove that entity from the board, record its position in the corresponding Alive collection, and continue sliding.
   * 10. If next cell is a normal traversable cell:
   *    - Continue sliding.
   * 11. When movement ends by a normal stopping condition after at least one step and no Mine was hit, return Alive.
   * Related Features:
   * - GameBoardController.gameBoard
   * - GameBoardController.makeMove(direction : Direction) : MoveResult
   * - GameBoard.player
   * - GameBoard.getCell2(position : Position) : Cell
   * - GameBoard.getEntityCell1(position : Position) : EntityCell
   * Related Classes: Alive, Dead, Direction, EntityCell, GameBoard, Gem, Invalid, Mine, MoveResult, Position, StopCell, Valid, Wall, ExtraLife
   * Input:
   * - direction: the intended sliding direction, one of UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT.
   * Output:
   * - Returns one of:
   *   - Invalid when the player cannot move even one cell.
   *   - Alive when the player slides at least one cell and stops normally without hitting a Mine.
   *   - Dead when the player slides into a Mine.
   * - For Alive, newPosition is the final player position and collectedGems/collectedExtraLives contain all collected item positions in travel order.
   * - For Dead, newPosition is the original player position and minePosition is the Mine location.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - gameBoard and player must be initialized.
   * - The board must be in a consistent state with valid positions and entity ownership.
   * - direction must be non-null.
   * Post-condition:
   * - If Alive:
   *   - player position is updated to the final position.
   *   - any traversed Gems and ExtraLives are removed from the board and recorded in the result.
   *   - board state reflects the move completion.
   * - If Dead:
   *   - player position is restored to the original position.
   *   - no board changes made during the attempt remain visible.
   * - If Invalid:
   *   - the board remains unchanged.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
  {
    GameBoard board = getGameBoard();
    Player player = board != null ? board.getPlayer() : null;
    if (board == null || player == null || direction == null)
    {
      return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP: dRow = -1; break;
      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;
      case RIGHT: dCol = 1; break;
    }

    Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
    Position current = originalPosition;
    boolean stepped = false;

    while (true)
    {
      Position next = current.offsetBy1(dRow, dCol);
      Cell nextCell = board.getCell2(next);
      if (nextCell == null)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof Wall)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof StopCell)
      {
        player.setPosition(next);
        alive.setNewPosition(next);
        return alive;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof EntityCell)
      {
        EntityCell entityCell = (EntityCell)nextCell;
        Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();
        if (entity instanceof Mine)
        {
          player.setPosition(originalPosition);
          Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
          dead.setNewPosition(originalPosition);
          dead.setMinePosition(next);
          return dead;
        }
        if (entity instanceof Gem)
        {
          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedGems().add(next);
        }
        else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
        {
          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedExtraLives().add(next);
        }
      }

      stepped = true;
      current = next;
    }
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Reverts the effects of a previously successful Alive move on the board.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. Read the previous MoveResult.
   * 2. If prevMove is not an Alive result, do nothing.
   * 3. Restore the player to the origPosition of the corresponding valid move.
   * 4. Reinsert any collected Gems and ExtraLives into their recorded positions.
   * 5. Ensure the board state matches the state before that move was executed.
   * Related Features:
   * - GameBoardController.gameBoard
   * - GameBoardController.undoMove(prevMove : MoveResult) : void
   * Related Classes: Alive, GameBoard, MoveResult, Position
   * Input:
   * - prevMove: the previously executed move result, expected to be an Alive result.
   * Output:
   * - None.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - prevMove should be an Alive move result produced by makeMove and still consistent with the current board history.
   * Post-condition:
   * - If prevMove is an Alive result, the board is restored to its prior state before that move.
   * - If prevMove is not undoable, the board remains unchanged.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void undoMove(final MoveResult prevMove)
  {
    if (!(prevMove instanceof Alive))
    {
      return;
    }

    GameBoard board = getGameBoard();
    if (board == null || board.getPlayer() == null)
    {
      return;
    }

    Alive alive = (Alive)prevMove;
    board.getPlayer().setPosition(((Valid)alive).getOrigPosition());

    for (Position p : alive.getCollectedGems())
    {
      EntityCell cell = board.getEntityCell1(p);
      if (cell != null)
      {
        cell.setEntity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createGem());
      }
    }

    for (Position p : alive.getCollectedExtraLives())
    {
      EntityCell cell = board.getEntityCell1(p);
      if (cell != null)
      {
        cell.setEntity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createExtraLife());
      }
    }
  }

    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP: dRow = -1; break;
      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;
      case RIGHT: dCol = 1; break;

        }
      }

      stepped = true;
      current = next;
    }

  public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
  {
    GameBoard board = getGameBoard();
    Player player = board != null ? board.getPlayer() : null;
    if (board == null || player == null || direction == null)
    {
      return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP: dRow = -1; break;
      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;
      case RIGHT: dCol = 1; break;
    }

    Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
    Position current = originalPosition;
    boolean stepped = false;

    while (true)
    {
      Position next = current.offsetBy1(dRow, dCol);
      Cell nextCell = board.getCell2(next);
      if (nextCell == null)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof Wall)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

        player.setPosition(next);
        alive.setNewPosition(next);
        return alive;
      }

        Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();

          dead.setNewPosition(originalPosition);
          dead.setMinePosition(next);
          return dead;

          alive.getCollectedGems().add(next);
        }
        else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
        {
          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedExtraLives().add(next);
        }
      }

      stepped = true;
      current = next;
    }

   * Summary:
   * Performs one inertial sliding move in the given Direction and returns the corresponding MoveResult.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. Obtain the player's current Position from the GameBoard.
   * 2. Convert Direction to a PositionOffset:
   *    - UP    -> (-1, 0)
   *    - DOWN  -> (1, 0)
   *    - LEFT  -> (0, -1)
   *    - RIGHT -> (0, 1)
   * 3. Initialize current position as the player's position and initialize empty collections for passed gems and extra lives.
   * 4. Repeatedly compute the next position by offsetting current position by one step.
   * 5. If next position is out of bounds:
   *    - If no step has been taken yet, return Invalid.
   *    - Otherwise return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.
   * 6. If next cell is a Wall:
   *    - If no step has been taken yet, return Invalid.
   *    - Otherwise stop immediately before the Wall and return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.
   * 7. If next cell is a StopCell:

   *    - The stop cell may contain only the Player.
   * 8. If next cell contains a Mine:

  public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
  {
    GameBoard board = getGameBoard();
    Player player = board != null ? board.getPlayer() : null;
    if (board == null || player == null || direction == null)
    {
      return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP: dRow = -1; break;
      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;
      case RIGHT: dCol = 1; break;
    }

    Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
    Position current = originalPosition;
    boolean stepped = false;

    while (true)
    {
      Position next = current.offsetBy1(dRow, dCol);
      Cell nextCell = board.getCell2(next);
      if (nextCell == null)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof Wall)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof StopCell)
      {
        player.setPosition(next);
        alive.setNewPosition(next);
        return alive;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof EntityCell)
      {
        EntityCell entityCell = (EntityCell)nextCell;
        Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();
        if (entity instanceof Mine)
        {
          player.setPosition(originalPosition);
          Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
          dead.setNewPosition(originalPosition);
          dead.setMinePosition(next);
          return dead;
        }
        if (entity instanceof Gem)
        {
          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedGems().add(next);
        }
        else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
        {
          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedExtraLives().add(next);
        }
      }

      stepped = true;
      current = next;
    }
  }

  {
    GameBoard board = getGameBoard();
    Player player = board != null ? board.getPlayer() : null;
    if (board == null || player == null || direction == null)
    {
      return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP: dRow = -1; break;
      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;
      case RIGHT: dCol = 1; break;
    }

    Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
    Position current = originalPosition;
    boolean stepped = false;

    while (true)
    {
      Position next = current.offsetBy1(dRow, dCol);
      Cell nextCell = board.getCell2(next);
      if (nextCell == null)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;

        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;

        player.setPosition(next);
        alive.setNewPosition(next);
        return alive;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof EntityCell)

        EntityCell entityCell = (EntityCell)nextCell;
        Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();
        if (entity instanceof Mine)

        {

          alive.getCollectedExtraLives().add(next);
        }
      }

      stepped = true;
      current = next;
    }
  }

   * Summary:
   * Performs one inertial sliding move in the given Direction and returns the corresponding MoveResult.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. Obtain the player's current Position from the GameBoard.
   * 2. Convert Direction to a PositionOffset:
   *    - UP    -> (-1, 0)
   *    - DOWN  -> (1, 0)
   *    - LEFT  -> (0, -1)
   *    - RIGHT -> (0, 1)
   * 3. Initialize current position as the player's position and initialize empty collections for passed gems and extra lives.

   * 5. If next position is out of bounds:
   *    - If no step has been taken yet, return Invalid.
   *    - Otherwise return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.
   * 6. If next cell is a Wall:
   *    - If no step has been taken yet, return Invalid.
   *    - Otherwise stop immediately before the Wall and return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.
   * 7. If next cell is a StopCell:

   *    - The stop cell may contain only the Player.

   *    - Return Dead with newPosition equal to the original player position and minePosition equal to the Mine position.
   * 9. If next cell contains a Gem or ExtraLife:

   * 10. If next cell is a normal traversable cell:
   *    - Continue sliding.
   * 11. When movement ends by a normal stopping condition after at least one step and no Mine was hit, return Alive.

  {
    GameBoard board = getGameBoard();
    Player player = board != null ? board.getPlayer() : null;
    if (board == null || player == null || direction == null)
    {
      return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP: dRow = -1; break;
      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;
      case RIGHT: dCol = 1; break;

    Position current = originalPosition;
    boolean stepped = false;

    while (true)
    {
      Position next = current.offsetBy1(dRow, dCol);
      Cell nextCell = board.getCell2(next);
      if (nextCell == null)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;

        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

        player.setPosition(next);
        alive.setNewPosition(next);
        return alive;
      }

        if (entity instanceof Mine)

          return dead;
        }
        if (entity instanceof Gem)

          alive.getCollectedGems().add(next);
        }
        else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
        {
          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedExtraLives().add(next);
        }
      }

      stepped = true;
      current = next;
    }
  }

    {

    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)

      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;

    {

    }

    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)

      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;
      case RIGHT: dCol = 1; break;

- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

   * Summary:
   * Performs one inertial sliding move in the given Direction and returns the corresponding MoveResult.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. Obtain the player's current Position from the GameBoard.
   * 2. Convert Direction to a PositionOffset:
   *    - UP    -> (-1, 0)
   *    - DOWN  -> (1, 0)
   *    - LEFT  -> (0, -1)
   *    - RIGHT -> (0, 1)
   * 3. Initialize current position as the player's position and initialize empty collections for passed gems and extra lives.
   * 4. Repeatedly compute the next position by offsetting current position by one step.
   * 5. If next position is out of bounds:
   *    - If no step has been taken yet, return Invalid.
   *    - Otherwise return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.
   * 6. If next cell is a Wall:
   *    - If no step has been taken yet, return Invalid.
   *    - Otherwise stop immediately before the Wall and return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.

   * 10. If next cell is a normal traversable cell:
   *    - Continue sliding.
   * 11. When movement ends by a normal stopping condition after at least one step and no Mine was hit, return Alive.

    GameBoard board = getGameBoard();
    Player player = board != null ? board.getPlayer() : null;
    if (board == null || player == null || direction == null)
    {
      return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP: dRow = -1; break;
      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;
      case RIGHT: dCol = 1; break;
    }

    Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
    Position current = originalPosition;
    boolean stepped = false;

    while (true)
    {
      Position next = current.offsetBy1(dRow, dCol);
      Cell nextCell = board.getCell2(next);
      if (nextCell == null)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof Wall)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof StopCell)
      {
        player.setPosition(next);
        alive.setNewPosition(next);
        return alive;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof EntityCell)
      {
        EntityCell entityCell = (EntityCell)nextCell;
        Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();
        if (entity instanceof Mine)
        {
          player.setPosition(originalPosition);
          Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
          dead.setNewPosition(originalPosition);
          dead.setMinePosition(next);
          return dead;

        {
          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedGems().add(next);
        }
        else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
        {
          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedExtraLives().add(next);
        }
      }

      stepped = true;
      current = next;
    }
  }

   * 9. If next cell contains a Gem or ExtraLife:
   *    - Remove that entity from the board, record its position in the corresponding Alive collection, and continue sliding.
   * 10. If next cell is a normal traversable cell:
   *    - Continue sliding.
   * 11. When movement ends by a normal stopping condition after at least one step and no Mine was hit, return Alive.
   * Related Features:
   * - GameBoardController.gameBoard
   * - GameBoardController.makeMove(direction : Direction) : MoveResult
   * - GameBoard.player
   * - GameBoard.getCell2(position : Position) : Cell

   * Related Classes: Alive, Dead, Direction, EntityCell, GameBoard, Gem, Invalid, Mine, MoveResult, Position, StopCell, Valid, Wall, ExtraLife
   * Input:
   * - direction: the intended sliding direction, one of UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT.
   * Output:
   * - Returns one of:
   *   - Invalid when the player cannot move even one cell.
   *   - Alive when the player slides at least one cell and stops normally without hitting a Mine.
   *   - Dead when the player slides into a Mine.
   * - For Alive, newPosition is the final player position and collectedGems/collectedExtraLives contain all collected item positions in travel order.
   * - For Dead, newPosition is the original player position and minePosition is the Mine location.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - gameBoard and player must be initialized.
   * - The board must be in a consistent state with valid positions and entity ownership.
   * - direction must be non-null.
   * Post-condition:
   * - If Alive:
   *   - player position is updated to the final position.
   *   - any traversed Gems and ExtraLives are removed from the board and recorded in the result.
   *   - board state reflects the move completion.
   * - If Dead:
   *   - player position is restored to the original position.
   *   - no board changes made during the attempt remain visible.
   * - If Invalid:
   *   - the board remains unchanged.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT

  public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
  {
    GameBoard board = getGameBoard();
    Player player = board != null ? board.getPlayer() : null;
    if (board == null || player == null || direction == null)
    {
      return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP: dRow = -1; break;
      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;
      case RIGHT: dCol = 1; break;
    }

    Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
    Position current = originalPosition;
    boolean stepped = false;

    while (true)
    {
      Position next = current.offsetBy1(dRow, dCol);
      Cell nextCell = board.getCell2(next);
      if (nextCell == null)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof Wall)
      {
        if (!stepped)
        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);
        return result;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof StopCell)
      {
        player.setPosition(next);
        alive.setNewPosition(next);
        return alive;
      }

      if (nextCell instanceof EntityCell)
      {
        EntityCell entityCell = (EntityCell)nextCell;
        Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();
        if (entity instanceof Mine)
        {
          player.setPosition(originalPosition);
          Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
          dead.setNewPosition(originalPosition);
          dead.setMinePosition(next);
          return dead;
        }
        if (entity instanceof Gem)
        {
          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedGems().add(next);
        }
        else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
        {
          entityCell.setEntity(null);
          alive.getCollectedExtraLives().add(next);
        }
      }

      stepped = true;
      current = next;
    }
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Reverts the effects of a previously successful Alive move on the board.
   * Algorithm:

   * 2. If prevMove is not an Alive result, do nothing.
   * 3. Restore the player to the origPosition of the corresponding valid move.

  public void undoMove(final MoveResult prevMove)

    {
      return;
    }

    GameBoard board = getGameBoard();
    if (board == null || board.getPlayer() == null)
    {
      return;
    }

    Alive alive = (Alive)prevMove;
    board.getPlayer().setPosition(((Valid)alive).getOrigPosition());

    for (Position p : alive.getCollectedGems())

      EntityCell cell = board.getEntityCell1(p);
      if (cell != null)
      {
        cell.setEntity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createGem());
      }
    }

    for (Position p : alive.getCollectedExtraLives())
    {
      EntityCell cell = board.getEntityCell1(p);
      if (cell != null)
      {
        cell.setEntity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createExtraLife());
      }
    }
  }

  {
    GameBoard board = getGameBoard();
    Player player = board != null ? board.getPlayer() : null;

    {
      return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP: dRow = -1; break;
      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;

   * Summary:
   * Performs one inertial sliding move in the given Direction and returns the corresponding MoveResult.
   * Algorithm:

   * 3. Initialize current position as the player's position and initialize empty collections for passed gems and extra lives.

   *    - Otherwise return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.
   * 6. If next cell is a Wall:

   *    - Otherwise stop immediately before the Wall and return Alive with newPosition equal to the last valid position.

    GameBoard board = getGameBoard();
    Player player = board != null ? board.getPlayer() : null;
    if (board == null || player == null || direction == null)
    {
      return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    }

    Position originalPosition = player.getPosition();
    int dRow = 0;
    int dCol = 0;
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP: dRow = -1; break;
      case DOWN: dRow = 1; break;
      case LEFT: dCol = -1; break;
      case RIGHT: dCol = 1; break;
    }

    boolean stepped = false;

      Cell nextCell = board.getCell2(next);
      if (nextCell == null)

        {
          return Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
        }
        Valid result = alive;
        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);

        result.setNewPosition(current);
        player.setPosition(current);

          alive.getCollectedExtraLives().add(next);
        }
      }

      stepped = true;
      current = next;
    }
